theorems.name: Submission.dimred_rpd_bilipschitz_image_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (χ : Euclid n → Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid n)) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ), 0 < c₁ → 0 ≤ c₂ → (∀ a ∈ E, ∀ b ∈ E, c₁ * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖χ a - χ b‖ ∧ ‖χ a - χ b‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖a - b‖) → ENNReal.ofReal (c₁ ^ n) * volume E ≤ μHE[n] (χ '' E) ∧ μHE[n] (χ '' E) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c₂ ^ n) * volume E
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
